notes: Fixed Mass Apply Jobs sometimes moving to the next job without actually submitting on LinkedIn. The final Submit click was verified the same way as Next/Review clicks ("did the on-screen text change") — but a validation error on the last step ALSO changes the text, so the engine could mistake a failed submit for a successful one and skip straight to the next job. It now only counts a submission as done once the Easy Apply form is genuinely gone; if a required field still needs you, it buzzes and waits like it always does mid-form, instead of silently moving on.
